result.stdout:
Usage: deming add --title <text> [--scope <text>] [--priority <1-3>] [--source human|agent] [--depends-on <ids>] | deming add <json>
  Add a task. Exit 4 when an unfinished task has the same title.
  Also: create, new
  Fields: give each as a flag, or give them all as one JSON object argument (or - to read it from stdin), not both:
    --title <text>  required
    --scope <text>  what to do, in the task's own words
    --priority <number>  1 (high) to 3 (low), default 2
    --source <text>  human | agent; default: agent with a session id, human without one
    --depends-on <ids> (JSON: dependsOn)  task ids this task waits for, like 3,4

Usage: deming update <id> [--title <text>] [--scope <text>] [--priority <1-3>] [--depends-on <ids>] | deming update <id> <json>

Usage: deming done <id> --summary <text> [--caveats <text>] [--touched-files <text>] [--commit-hash <hash>] [--takeover] | deming done <id> <json> [--takeover]
  Close a task with a handoff note. --takeover closes a task another session holds.
  Also: finish, complete
  Needs a session id: DEMING_SESSION_ID, otherwise CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID.
  Fields: give each as a flag, or give them all as one JSON object argument (or - to read it from stdin), not both:
    --summary <text>  required, 800 characters
    --caveats <text>  800 characters
    --touched-files <text> (JSON: touchedFiles)  one string of at most 1500 characters: the paths and what changed in each, not a reading list
    --commit-hash <text> (JSON: commitHash)
    --takeover  close a task another session holds (works with a JSON argument too)
